title: LLMOPS Industry Ready Projects
_comment_overview: PARAPHRASED from the krishnaik.in landing page (id=4) — never copy marketing prose verbatim. Facts (fee, duration, module count, tool stack, nine portfolio projects) are used as-is.
overview: A 4-5 month live cohort from Krish Naik Academy that walks practitioners through the full LLMOps pipeline, from foundational NLP and prompt engineering to production-grade generative AI systems. Seven project-based modules cover retrieval-augmented generation, agentic workflows with MCP integration, fine-tuning and serverless deployment on AWS, and multimodal vision-language applications. The course closes with hands-on delivery of production concerns — containerisation, CI/CD, monitoring and prompt evaluation — across nine portfolio projects including a PDF assistant, a search agent, a voice chatbot and a custom fine-tuned LLM.
_comment_category: Primary is unambiguous — the course's own name and 'What You Will Learn' section centre on the LLMOps pipeline (fine-tuning, dockerization, CI/CD, monitoring, prompt evaluation). 'GenAI / LLM Engineering' secondary for the RAG/multimodal/LLM-API modules; 'Agentic AI' secondary for the MCP-enabled and multi-agent modules (3 and 4); 'Cloud' secondary for module 5's dedicated AWS SageMaker/Lambda/API Gateway/S3/DynamoDB serverless deployment.
_comment_level: Page states explicit prerequisites — good Python coding, basics of NLP and deep learning, and basic knowledge of generative AI — which rules out a pure-beginner anchor, matching the sibling agentic-ai-agentops-bootcamp-3-0's identical prerequisite framing. No wide beginner-to-advanced span is claimed for the audience itself (the 'basics to mastery' line describes curriculum breadth, not who can enrol), so no level_range was added.
_comment_price: ₹6500.00 stated inclusive of GST, own-site cohort pricing, not coupon-driven — a number is safe here. Band 'mid' per §2 (₹3,000-9,999). Identical fee to the sibling generative-ai-for-everyone-professionals-and-leaders course, confirmed independently on this page's own 'Course Fee' block.
_comment_rating: No star rating or review count published on the page. Null, not guessed — the validator's null-rating warning is expected.

_comment_objectives: §1 corroboration rule applied — nothing dropped. Each objective maps to a module: (1)->module 1 (project setup) + LLM API tool stack, (2)->module 2 (RAG portal), (3)->module 5 (fine-tuning + serverless deployment), (4)->modules 3-4 (MCP e-commerce assistant, multi-agent research), (5)->module 7 (semantic image search) + multimodal tool stack, (6)->module 6 (end-to-end ML deployment project) + Production & Scaling section.
_comment_modules: 7 flat curriculum modules clustered into the course's OWN 6 'What You Will Learn' thematic section headings (used here as group names, matching the convention set by the sibling agentic-ai-agentops-bootcamp-3-0 file). Module 6 ('Network Intrusion Detection Using Machine Learning') is a traditional-ML project, not LLM-specific — it has no dedicated 'What You Will Learn' section of its own, so it is placed in 'Production & Scaling' as the course's example of a complete end-to-end deployment-and-monitoring pipeline, consistent with that section's stated theme.
